item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q010_rossmann_family_function_divergence","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, Alcohol dehydrogenase-like, C-terminal domain, CoA-binding domain, and Potassium channel NAD-binding domain are three different families, not one interchangeable annotation: c.2.1.1 / SUNID 51736, c.2.1.8 / SUNID 51900, and c.2.1.9 / SUNID 63944, respectively. All three are sibling families below the NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains superfamily c.2.1 / SUNID 51735, which sits in the identically named fold c.2 / SUNID 51734 in class c, Alpha and beta proteins (a/b). Thus a biologist should read SCOPe as grouping them at Rossmann NAD(P)-binding superfamily/fold depth, while deliberately separating them at the family level. Family membership supports closer homology within each named group; superfamily membership supports a much more remote evolutionary relationship among the three families, centered on the Rossmann-like nucleotide-binding core, and it is not enough by itself to transfer precise substrate chemistry, CoA binding, potassium-channel/RCK regulation, NAD versus NADP preference, domain boundaries, or oligomeric context from one family to another. Representatives or templates should therefore be chosen from the same family when the question depends on detailed active-site, ligand-binding, or channel-regulatory function; cross-family representatives are useful mainly as remote Rossmann-fold structural templates. The potassium-channel family is separately annotated with Pfam PF02254, and the alcohol-dehydrogenase-like family carries a SCOPe comment that its N-terminal all-beta domain defines that family, both of which reinforce that the biological family names capture more than the shared C-terminal Rossmann fold alone.","evidence_used":["get_scop_service_info: /api/v1/releases/current","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.2.1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.2.1/parents","list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.2.1/children?limit=100","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736/homology","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900/homology","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944/homology"]}]}
